Let me start by saying I WANTED to love this place. Everyone on my feed has been raving about it for months and the photos are gorgeous. Reality? mixed bag.

We had a 7:30 reservation. Didnt get seated til 8:15. Fine, it happens, places get busy. But nobody told us anything, we just stood by the host stand like lemons while two different people walked past us. When we finally sat down the waiter was genuinely lovely, shoutout to Diego, that man carried the whole experience.

The food. The branzino was perfect, no notes, id go back just for that. The pasta though? bland. For 28 dollars i expected more than what tasted like it needed about three times the salt. And the "famous" tiramisu was fine. just fine. not the religious experience instagram promised.

Two stars feels harsh because parts of it were genuinely great. but i cant ignore an hour wait with no communication. fix the front of house and this is easily a 4 star spot. ill maybe give it another shot in a few months when the hype dies down.
